uses: Tests applyDarkModeFilter, invertDarkModeFilter, COLOR_PALETTE, and DEFAULT_CANVAS_BACKGROUND_PICKS.

acceptance: returns input color unchanged when enable is false: given A dark-mode hex string such as #d3d3d3 and enable = false, expect invertDarkModeFilter("#d3d3d3", false) returns "#d3d3d3"

reproduces every COLOR_PALETTE and DEFAULT_CANVAS_BACKGROUND_PICKS color with exact hex equality: given Every color c in COLOR_PALETTE (black, white, transparent, and all 60 shades) and DEFAULT_CANVAS_BACKGROUND_PICKS, expect invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(c)) === c and applyDarkModeFilter(invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(c))) === applyDarkModeFilter(c)

inverts unclamped custom colors within +-3 per channel and preserves exact on-screen round trip: given Unclamped custom colors #6496c8 (dark #4d78a3) and quantization-colliding pair #585858 / #595959 (dark #a1a1a1), expect invertDarkModeFilter("#4d78a3") === "#6496c8", invertDarkModeFilter("#a1a1a1") === "#595959", per-channel difference from #585858 is <= 3, and applyDarkModeFilter(invertDarkModeFilter(x)) === x

inverts clamped saturated custom colors (#ff00ff, #ff0000, #00ff00, #0000ff) to canonical preimages with exact on-screen round trip: given Clamped saturated colors #ff00ff (dark #ff70ff), #ff0000 (dark #ff9090), #00ff00 (dark #008f00), and #0000ff (dark #cdcdff), expect invertDarkModeFilter("#ff70ff") === "#d832d8", invertDarkModeFilter("#ff9090") === "#b73636", and applyDarkModeFilter(invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(c))) === applyDarkModeFilter(c) for all four

preserves alpha channel across hex8, rgba, and transparent inputs: given Alpha colors #ff000080, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5), #ff000000, and transparent transformed via applyDarkModeFilter, expect invertDarkModeFilter preserves the alpha suffix (80, 00) and returns "transparent" for transparent

uses: Exercises EyeDropper pointermove, pointerdown, and pointerup listeners in dark and light themes.

acceptance: picks exact stored palette color (#1e1e1e) in dark theme instead of dark-mode pixel (#d3d3d3): given Dark theme with a solid rectangle of backgroundColor #1e1e1e at (10, 10, 100, 100) and canvas getImageData returning [211, 211, 211, 255] (#d3d3d3), expect Picking at (50, 50) sets window.h.state.currentItemBackgroundColor to "#1e1e1e"

picks exact stored clamped saturated color (#ff00ff) from shape under cursor in dark theme: given Dark theme with a solid rectangle of backgroundColor #ff00ff at (10, 10, 100, 100) and canvas getImageData returning [255, 112, 255, 255] (#ff70ff), expect Picking at (50, 50) sets window.h.state.currentItemBackgroundColor to "#ff00ff"

resolves tie in favor of the shape under the cursor when two shapes render to the same dark-mode pixel (#ff00ff vs #d832d8): given Dark theme with Shape A (#ff00ff at 10,10,80,80) and Shape B (#d832d8 at 200,10,80,80), both rendering [255, 112, 255, 255] (#ff70ff), expect Picking at (40, 40) saves "#ff00ff" and picking at (240, 40) saves "#d832d8"

resolves overlapping shapes in z-order under the cursor when an unmatched shape sits above #ff00ff and a colliding #d832d8 shape sits elsewhere at higher z-index: given Dark theme with a bottom #ff00ff solid shape at (10,10,100,100), a middle hachured shape (#12b886 / #1e1e1e) overlapping at (10,10,100,100), and a top #d832d8 shape at (300,300,80,80), expect Picking pixel [255, 112, 255, 255] (#ff70ff) at (50, 50) saves "#ff00ff"

disambiguates strokeColor vs backgroundColor on a single shape in dark theme based on sampled pixel: given Dark theme with a solid rectangle at (10,10,100,100) having strokeColor #ff00ff (dark #ff70ff) and backgroundColor #1e1e1e (dark #d3d3d3), expect Picking when getImageData returns [255, 112, 255, 255] saves "#ff00ff" and when getImageData returns [211, 211, 211, 255] saves "#1e1e1e"

falls back to invertDarkModeFilter when no shape under cursor matches in dark theme and preserves raw pixel in light theme: given Empty canvas at (400, 400) returning [77, 120, 163, 255] (#4d78a3) in dark theme, and [211, 211, 211, 255] (#d3d3d3) in light theme, expect Dark theme saves "#6496c8" and light theme saves "#d3d3d3"
